jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE standalone idle PLAYER SPRITE, not a sheet, full body, for a native 64-PIXEL-TALL game character, head-to-boot silhouette exactly 64 logical pixels high. The model output may display enlarged logical pixels for inspection, but design ALL art on that single native logical pixel grid. High-quality TRUE PIXEL ART, crisp rectangular clusters, stair-step edges, no antialiasing, no smooth curves, no gradients, no blurry outlines, no subpixel detail or semitransparent pixels. Image1 is exact hero identity/pose/style reference cropped from approved cemetery pixel test P; ignore and REMOVE its scenery. Same dark tousled hair, visible face turned toward LOWER-RIGHT (southeast) in 3/4 topdown RPG view, large grey scarf, ragged dark ash-grey cloak, brown leather diagonal strap and broad belt, buckles, bracers, dark trousers, worn boots. Sword held lowered in near hand, short blade points diagonally LOWER-RIGHT, keep it compact and attached close to body, no large detached weapon effect. Neutral standing idle, calm posture, both complete boots visible and sole contact levels approximately aligned, stable feet midpoint under pelvis. No turning away, no front-facing pose, no black faceless hood, no chibi proportions. Use bold economy: readable 8-10px head, clear face direction, a few large pixel clusters for cloak folds, sparse buckle pixels, no micro-noise. Palette at most47 visible colors, cold muted grey/slate and low-saturation brown/taupe, same palette family as reference P, only3-4 tones per material. Entire sprite centered, fully contained in central60% of image, ample empty margin all sides. CRITICAL Background 100% uniform solid #FF00FF MAGENTA, no ground surface, tile, stone, grass, shadow, drop shadow, halo, glow, border, labels, letters, extra items or UI. No cast or contact shadow. Exactly ONE character, no size comparisons within image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE standalone UPRIGHT TOMBSTONE prop sprite, not a sheet. Native visible height 51 logical PIXELS, designed to stand next to a 64-pixel hero. High-quality TRUE PIXEL ART matching image1 cropped from the approved cemetery pixel scene P. Keep the same rounded arch top, thick simple grey stone tablet with restrained inset border, worn/chipped edges, a few large crisp cracks, faint grey-olive moss traces on one edge, no readable letters or inscriptions. Material cold desaturated grey slate and muted grey olive, muted taupe, at most47 visible colors, same family as reference P. Narrow upright proportion, width about55-60% of height. View 3/4 topdown RPG: upright front face, a modest visible top thickness and right side face, NOT isometric, NOT lying flat. ONE coherent logical pixel grid throughout, crisp designed clusters and stepped edges. Use bold economy: readable 8-10px head, clear face direction, a few large pixel clusters for cloak folds, sparse buckle pixels, no micro-noise. Straight vertical posture, tablet NOT tilted, flat small bottom foot integral to stone, no ground patch or detached rocks. Entire stone centered inside central60% safe region with large empty margin all sides. Pure solid #FF00FF MAGENTA background, no antialiasing, no smooth curves, no painterly brush marks, no gradients, no blur or semitransparent edges. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no lighting halo, no scenery, grass, floor, text, labels, border, frame or UI. Exactly ONE complete tombstone.
